propositions: E6 measures LLM-judge self-consistency by re-judging 50 existing findings from the G6/E4/T3 routing cohort (Pass-2/Pass-3 vocabulary stability prerequisite for R5) via 3 votes per finding, computing Fleiss' κ and raw agreement over the decision variable, passing iff κ≥0.6 AND raw_agreement≥0.8.

E6 measures order-shuffle verdict stability by running the gate over 14 distinct plans with ≥3 top-level sections, generating 3 deterministically-seeded distinct section-order permutations per plan (identity + 2 shuffles), and computing κ and raw agreement on verdict, passing iff κ≥0.6 AND raw_agreement≥0.8 (R3 prerequisite).

Infra-INDETERMINATE verdicts (marked with coverage.llm_unavailable or coverage.verify_failed) are execution failures and excluded; E6 re-runs permutations/votes carrying these flags until substantive decisions are collected or an explicit exclusion is recorded.

Self-consistency experiment (Exp A) runs 50 findings × 3 votes = 150 agentic Pass-2 calls with frozen, committed plan text from runs/e6_selfconsistency_inputs.jsonl; Pass-3 decision derivation is deterministic given Pass-2 output.

Order-shuffle experiment (Exp B) drives the public review_plan entrypoint against a throwaway REBAR_TRACKER_DIR store clone (real store unmodified) with permuted section order, recording verdicts and metrics to runs/e6_ordershuffle.jsonl.

Agreement metrics (Fleiss' κ, raw exact-agreement) and pass/fail thresholds (κ≥0.6 AND raw≥0.8) are unit-tested on fixtures and documented in runs/README.md; Exp A pass result gates R5, Exp B pass result gates R3.
